text: Environmental science and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates environmental science, engineering technology, management, and ecology, aiming to study the formation mechanism, evolution laws, and solutions of environmental problems. This major takes "sustainable development" as its core, focusing on areas such as environmental pollution control, ecological protection, and resource recycling. Through the combination of theoretical research and engineering practice, it aims to cultivate compound talents with capabilities in environmental monitoring, pollution control, environmental planning, and management.
